steps.title: Short Steps
steps.explanation: To evaluate the contour integral \(\int_{|z|=4} \frac{1}{(z-1.26)(z-5.89)} \, dz\), we will use the residue theorem. The residue theorem states that for a function \(f(z)\) analytic inside and on a simple closed contour \(C\) except at a finite number of singular points inside \(C\), the integral is given by: \[ \int_C f(z) \, dz = 2\pi i \sum \text{Res}(f, z_k) \] where the sum is over all the singular points \(z_k\) inside \(C\).
